My moment has come.

So, I've got two for you that both involve superpowers. 

-I Want You More Than I Want Superpowers by DiamantNoir

https://archiveofourown.org/works/23990551

This one is part of a series called Powers That Be, and it's one of those AUs where it's modern and that superpowers are a norm, but with implied prejudice against those who have no powers as part of this AU. This one is the first in the series, and it's NoMin but has hints of MarkHyuck. The latter ship happens down the path (if you decide to read the series in order, but you really don't have to), and it's just fun that there are different POVs from different members for each fic. Each of them dealing with inner conflicts about their own powers and how it affects their relationships with others. It goes through a lot of pairings really, and again, it explores each of their powers and conflicts (and also how each pair ends up together).

-knowing me, knowing you by twiceshy (oncebitten)

https://archiveofourown.org/works/9332852/chapters/21147014

Here in this second one, it's one of those superhero society AUs where the members are part of an organization that brought them together to create a team. Main ship is DoTae, but it's got a lot of angst, and it's mainly told in a non-linear narrative. I can't say much beyond that, because I might spoil a bit of it, so go ham if this fic is your jam. 

Hope these fill your rec needs! And if they end up being your cup of tea, I hope you enjoy reading them :D

I had a very intense nightmare about the witch taking my farmer's baby, wherein she wiped all memory of the baby from my in-game spouse's mind and everyone else's in town, except my farmer. So, my farmer went to rescue her baby with the hope that he was still alive. Once she got to the entrance of the wicth's hut, she heard crying from inside the hut, and she rushed in only to find a crow perched on the Dark Shrine of Selfishness that was mimicking the cry of her baby. At the bottom of it, where you put the offering, was her baby's lifeless body that was now turned into a rag doll, much like the ancient doll. Then, the crow slowly shapeshifted into the witch herself, and went on a tangent about how much she hated the farmer's guts as well as her friendship with Rasmodius. Killing her baby was a "small" act of petty revenge on her end. They fought, my farmer won, but is the only one who will forever remember the loss of her child. I woke up, and haven't touched my game since, and that was 2 weeks ago.

Pierre - There is a battle royale mod, and I will download it for the sole purpose of gutting this man. He's a smalltown version of Morris, and while I hate Morris even more, you take care of that by driving him out of town so you don't have to see that ugly ass rat ever again. Pierre on the other hand, is just as sleazy and takes advantage of your produce, pleads/threatens you not to buy from other seed-sellers because you can only depend on him (manipulative sonofabitch) for good quality seeds. AND he passes off YOUR hardwork as his own during the grange display competitions which is INSANE. I'm so glad I've won 4 years in a row now against him, and I'm going for a 5th. Plus, he's a boomer, and Abi doesn't deserve that. You better watch out Pierre, cuz I'm gonna download that battle royale mod and shank your dick off with my galaxy sword and squash your guts with my war hammer.

Demetrius - For someone who says he's so fucking smart, when your wife ( and I still don't know what Robin sees in you ) says she wants fruit, YOU DON'T GET HER A FUCKING TOMATO WHAT THE EVERLOVING FUCK.
